name: Jasper
description: Jasper is an AI platform aimed at marketing teams, with agents, brand voices and a canvas for content creation.
features: Brand voices, knowledge assets and audiences
No-code custom agents and API access (Business)
useCases: Keeping a consistent brand voice across campaigns
strengths: Nonprofit discount of 20% after starting a trial (subject to review)
limitations: Pro includes 1 seat (the page is inconsistent about team size)
Cards only: PayPal, prepaid cards and cash apps are not accepted

plans.name: Pro
plans.billing: Annual billing is a 12-month commitment; monthly plans can be cancelled anytime

plans.name: Business
highlights: No-code agent builder and Jasper Grid
Unlimited Brand Voices, knowledge assets and audiences
API access, admin controls, dedicated support

pricing.trial: 7-day free trial of the Pro plan; trial limits are not stated.
pricing.regional: Prices are in USD; exchange rates are applied at purchase by Stripe. Tax treatment: not stated.
notes: The page's structured data lists a 'Creator' plan that does not appear elsewhere, and a price validity date of 2025-12-31.

verification.notes: Product active. The pricing FAQ states Pro is $59/month billed yearly or $69/month billed monthly, and Business is custom. A free trial is offered; the trial length was not re-read.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

profile.headline: An AI platform for marketing teams, with brand knowledge built in

capabilities.title: Work in one marketing workspace
capabilities.text: Canvas is the workspace where marketers work with Jasper.

capabilities.title: Keep output on-brand
capabilities.text: Jasper IQ stores brand and company knowledge, including Brand Voice, Visual Guidelines, Style Guide, Product IQ and a Knowledge base.

capabilities.title: Use agents for marketing tasks
capabilities.text: Purpose-built agents cover work such as GEO, research and translation, with a library of more agents.

capabilities.title: See how AI answer engines describe your brand
capabilities.text: GEO and AI Optimization measures brand visibility in AI answers, finds gaps and generates brand-governed content.

featureCards.name: AI Studio
featureCards.text: Build custom agents and deploy them across the workspace.

featureCards.name: Content pipelines and Jasper Grid
featureCards.text: Scale content production and adapt campaigns across regions and languages.

featureCards.name: Image Pipelines and Image APIs
featureCards.text: On-brand product imagery, with tasks such as background removal and upscaling.

featureCards.name: API, MCP and integrations
featureCards.text: Connect Jasper to the rest of your stack and bring performance data back as context.

featureCards.name: Diagnostics
featureCards.text: A GEO Diagnostic and a Brand Compliance Diagnostic scan visibility and governance.

audienceDetail.text: Content, brand, and PR and communications marketers are all named.
Both roles are named on the site.
Financial services and healthcare and life sciences are named among the industries.

scenarios.title: Monitor how AI tools describe your brand
scenarios.text: Then produce content to close visibility gaps.

scenarios.title: Write SEO and AEO content
scenarios.text: Content that aims to rank and build authority.

scenarios.title: Personalise campaigns
scenarios.text: Target specific accounts, contacts, leads or opportunities.

scenarios.title: Localise a campaign
scenarios.text: Adapt content for different regions and audiences.

gettingStarted.step: Start a free trial or ask for a demo
gettingStarted.text: Both are offered on the site.

gettingStarted.step: Work with a Forward Deployed Expert
gettingStarted.text: They identify the best starting point and assess your data and systems.

gettingStarted.step: Define success and build the first workflow
gettingStarted.text: The experts help set the goal and the first agent or pipeline.
